comments.author: jakevdp
comments.body: Hi - I think unfortunately this is working as expected: `jax.numpy.save` (which is a thin wrapper of `numpy.save`) is meant to save array objects, and `ShapeDtypeStruct` is not an array object. For doing anything more sophisticated, you'll need another tool. One option is [orbax](https://orbax.readthedocs.io/en/latest/), and in particular the `orbax-export` tools.
